reconstruction_notes.en: Geological-form artistic concept: representative three-metre-wide landscape outcrop with broad gently inclined limestone surfaces separated by deep continuous dissolution fissures. Unequal curved joint paths, softened shoulders and common lower rock express clints/grikes rather than industrial tiles, polygon columns or enlarged mud cracks. Nominal depth, spacing, crop thickness and gray palette are art choices, not a measured ancient site. Original biomes cave and scale_class landscape retained; no seawater erosion, mapped coastline, exact age or coexisting habitat claim.
